objective: Real wave fights: a wave gate at the arena, the server deciding and paying a fight with the player's own team (coins, XP, samples), the arena replaying it with a result panel, one fight at a time and no faster farming by skipping; and a dark glow instead of the green aura.
acceptance_criteria: Waves open one at a time up to one past the best cleared, and a fight needs an animal on the team
A win pays coins, XP and samples once, records the best, and a replay pays a quarter; a loss pays nothing

In Studio play a player can hatch a team, open the wave gate, fight wave 1 with the button, see the replay and the result panel, and be paid; a loss, a wave that is not open, a second fight at once and leaving the arena behave as described
The Hexbound have a dark glow and no green disc
